benefits.target: every choice has a decision row
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: Count decision rows per run from the action ledger.

benefits.target: every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: The tool_call ledger's per-toolkit counts, read at the tranche review; retirement is a decision.

benefits.target: one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: The development project's run, CI and deploy records; the lane and PR are the evidence.

benefits.target: at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: The GitHub issue registry and merged PR authors; the publications are recorded on the programme issues.

benefits.target: the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: The T0 gate test and the absorption inventory; a second store is a defect.

benefits.target: the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review
benefits.baseline: not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)
benefits.measurement_method: coverage.json and seed/programme.json regenerated and checked in CI; the P0 checklist counts the published set.

benefits.target: every tranche-4 cross-department decision has a meeting record with a position per required department; quorum-miss and commitment slippage are reported at the review
benefits.baseline: not measured - no meeting rows exist before T19; the current record is the approval row only
benefits.measurement_method: Read-time aggregates over meeting, meeting_agenda_item, meeting_attendance, meeting_position, approval_decision and project_dependency; a metric reads rows and writes nothing.
